extensions.name: Bear import
extensions.description: Brings in Bear notes exported as TextBundle (Bear: File, Export Notes, TextBundle; pick the folder or a zip of it). Pictures and #tags are kept.
extensions.author: Notation

extensions.name: Blog page export
extensions.description: Saves the open note as a page for a static site (Hugo, Jekyll, Eleventy): Markdown with a front matter of the title, the date and the tags.
extensions.author: Notation

extensions.name: Chess boards
extensions.description: A code block written with the language chess (a position in FEN) is drawn as a chess board in the document. Click into it to change the position.
extensions.author: Notation

extensions.name: Daily note
extensions.description: A command that makes today's note (or tells you it is there): from the template you write in its settings, tagged daily. Bind it to a key in Settings, Keyboard shortcuts.
extensions.author: Notation

extensions.name: Evernote import
extensions.description: Brings in notes from Evernote .enex files (File, Export notes in Evernote): text with its formatting, checklists, links, tags and pictures. Notebooks you export one by one become folders by their file names.
extensions.author: Notation

extensions.name: Google Keep import
extensions.description: Brings in notes from a Google Takeout of Keep (the zip, or the Keep folder): text notes, checklists, labels as tags, pictures. Trashed notes are left out.
extensions.author: Notation

extensions.name: Joplin import
extensions.description: Brings in a Joplin export: the .jex file (File, Export all, JEX) or the folder of a RAW export. Notebooks become folders, tags and pictures are kept, links between notes keep working.
extensions.author: Notation

extensions.name: Simplenote import
extensions.description: Brings in the notes of a Simplenote export (the zip, or its notes.json): the first line is the title, tags are kept, notes in the trash are left out.
extensions.author: Notation

extensions.name: Standard Notes import
extensions.description: Brings in an unencrypted backup of Standard Notes (the .txt/.json file the app saves): titles, text and tags. Trashed notes are left out; an encrypted backup is explained, not guessed at.
extensions.author: Notation

extensions.name: YouTube transcripts
extensions.description: Gets the captions of a YouTube video for "New note from a transcript". Asks YouTube for the video's caption list and downloads one track (the video's own language, written by a person if there is one, else the automatic one). Talks to www.youtube.com only. YouTube does not offer this for outside use and can change it at any time; if it stops working, an update of this extension fixes it.
extensions.author: Notation
